about: What the world sounds like where the listener stands (Soundscapes.cs, backlog #9). Every soundscape whose 'near' and 'hours' hold plays its loops together; a loop in several plays once, at the loudest volume. 'near' counts cells within 'within' cells (a square round the listener): 'terrain' ids or a terrain 'tag', or cells holding at least 'water' units, and holds when there are 'atLeast' of them. 'village': true holds inside a village (its bounds grown by 'within'); 'building' holds within 'within' cells of a village building of that kind (inn, shop, house). 'hours' is [from, to] on the world clock, across midnight when from is the later (Sky.InHours); without it, any hour. 'sound' names a loop for the view to play (Gameplay maps the names to clips); 'volume' is 0 to 1. The falls' roar is the view's own (WaterfallFx), not here.
